Subject: Clarifying candidate feedback and offer timing for Alex Jensen (Sr Infra)

Hi Monica / Marcus,

Quick one — Alex Jensen (candidate) completed interviews last week for the Senior Infrastructure Engineer role. I'm seeing mixed signals in the interviewer notes (attached) and want to align before we move to an offer. Specifics:

- One interviewer called out 'uncertainty on large-scale cache invalidation patterns' and recommended a mid-Senior hire.
- Two others rated Alex as clearly Senior with strong systems design and deployment experience.

Marcus, you flagged Alex as a strong hire and asked me to expedite given his competing offers. Monica, can you confirm the approved compensation band for Senior Infra in US-west, and whether we have room to front-load equity if we need to close quickly?

Proposed next steps:
1) Short calibration call with the interview panel (30 min) today if possible.
2) HR recommendation on level + target comp band.
3) If we agree on level, I'll authorize an expedited approval path for the offer.

Attachments: alex_jensen_resume.pdf, interview-notes-20260801.docx

Thanks — trying to avoid losing him.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying candidate feedback and offer timing for Alex Jensen (Sr Infra)

Thanks Evelyn — I pulled the notes and looked up the banding. A few points:

- Approved band for Senior Infra (US-west): Base $165k–$185k, Target total comp (incl. equity) $220k–$260k depending on experience and market stretch.
- We can make a one-time equity front-load up to +15% relative to the midpoint with Director approval; cash upside requires stronger justification.
- HR needs a clear leveling rationale from the hiring manager + consolidated interview feedback to approve going above midpoint.

Marcus — can you provide a short bullet justification (2–3 lines) for Senior vs Mid-Senior? If you need an expedited Director sign-off, I can route to Priya in People Ops but will need the justification and the candidate's counteroffer timeline.

I can host a 20–30 min calibration call this afternoon at 4:00 PM PT — let me know if that works. I've also linked the hiring ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HIRE-324

--
Monica Patel
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying candidate feedback and offer timing for Alex Jensen (Sr Infra)

Evelyn / Monica — thanks for flagging. Short justification for Senior:

- Alex has >7 years running infra teams and designed multi-region deployment patterns at previous company (see interview notes, page 3).
- Demonstrated ownership on runbooks, incident postmortems, and capacity planning — all at the scale we need.
- Gaps noted (cache invalidation specifics) were scoped to a particular tech used at one site; not systemic in my view.

Given that Alex has an external offer expiring Friday (8/6), I recommend we table the strong Senior title and present an offer with base $180k + signing equity that gets total comp near $245k (within band, with equity front-load). If we need to move above $185k base, I'll accept that only if Priya signs off.

I'll be on the 4:00 PM PT calibration call and will summarize the panel feedback live.

Marcus
Director, Platform Engineering
